ACTION MINUTES
  CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION

  Special Meeting
  June 1, 2020

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:30 pm via teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Tang, Yee, E. Garcia,
  Sanchez

  Absent:  Gardea

  Commissioner D. Garcia arrived at 6:42 P.M.
  Commissioner Tang arrived at 7:46 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director, Paul Lam, Principal Planner, Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner, Greg Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  ITEM 1:  MINUTES OF JUNE 3, 2019
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  ITEM 2:  MINUTES OF JUNE 17, 2019
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  ITEM 3:  MINUTES OF JULY 15, 2019
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  ITEM 4:  MINUTES OF MAY 18, 2020
  Recommended Action: Approve as submitted.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Calendar Items 1, 2, 3, 4
  •  Moved by Commissioner Messina, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dunkel-Soto

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0

  Sanchez

D.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  ITEM 5:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TT 82480 AND RESIDENTIAL
  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT RP-16-22
  • Address: 110 South Chapel Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Tentative Tract Map (TT 82480)
  and Residential Planned Development Permit (RP-16-22) to construct
  a 24,052 square foot, 24-unit residential condominium complex on a
  site of approximately 39,761 square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple
  Family Residential) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 20-11 approving
  Tentative Tract Map TT 82480 and Residential Planned Development
  Permit RP-16-22 subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation and read
  into the record an email received.
  • Commissioner Questions: Commissioners had questions regarding
  the timeline for construction, the property owner’s handling of the
  tenant eviction process, and timing and coordination of Edison’s quit
  claim of the existing easements. Anita To, applicant, Carl Wong,
  property owner, Vincent Tsoi, project architect, responded to the
  Commission’s questions.
  • Public Comments: Six (6) existing tenants of 110 S. Chapel Ave.
  questioned if there would be any relocation assistance or any other
  forms of help from the property owner to the existing tenants. The
  property owner of 106 S. Chapel Ave. expressed privacy concerns.
  • Commissioner Comments: Commissioners supported a condition
  of approval requiring a minimum 6-month notice of eviction. Some
  Commissioners supported some form of assistance from the property
  owner to the tenants. Discussion ensued regarding the Tenant
  Protection Act of 2019 and the issue of no-fault evictions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Tentative Tract Map TT 82480 and Residential
  Planned Development Permit RP-16-22 with an amendment to
  Condition of Approval PL31 and added Condition of Approval PL34.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Dunkel-
  Soto.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0

  2
  6/1/2020
   Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Tang,
  Yee, E. Garcia, Sanchez
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Gardea

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/134Ft_FwuJKjhg1RuKaokUrGQtBrr
  1sEX/view.

ITEM 6:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-19-11
  • Address: 560 West Main Street, Unit B
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to
  establish an online computer gaming center in an existing 1,335
  square foot commercial lease space previously used for retail
  purposes in a commercial and residential mixed-use development on
  an approximate land area of 92,090 square feet located in the CPD
  (Commercial Planned Development) zone.
  • Recommended Action:  Adopt Resolution 20-12 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CU-19-11 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation.
  • Jasmine Fang, applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • Commissioner Questions: Commissioners clarified the business
  hours and possible noise issues relating to existing outdoor patio
  seating.
  • Public Comments: There were none.
  • Commissioner Comments: There were none.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Conditional Use Permit CU-19-11.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner D.
  Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Tang,
  Yee, E. Garcia, Sanchez
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Gardea

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/134Ft_FwuJKjhg1RuKaokUrGQtBrr
  1sEX/view.
  3
  6/1/2020
   ITEM 7:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-04
  • Address: 35 West Valley Boulevard, Unit C
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  to establish a boba tea cafe within an existing 899 square foot
  commercial unit, located in the Valley Boulevard Specific Plan zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 20-16 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-20-04 subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided staff presentation and read
  into the record emails received.
  • David Fung, property owner, spoke in favor of the proposal and was
  available for questions.
  • Commissioner Questions: There were none.
  • Public Comments: There were none.
  • Commissioner Comments: There was discussion pertaining to the
  parking needs of the proposed business and the other businesses
  located on the property. Some Commissioners raised the question of
  the availability of on-site parking and street parking in the adjacent
  residential neighborhood.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Planned Development Permit PD-20-04.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Yee, Seconded by Commissioner Chan
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Tang,
  Yee, E. Garcia, Sanchez
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Gardea

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/134Ft_FwuJKjhg1RuKaokUrGQtBrr
  1sEX/view.

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of the
